name: Sant Andreu de Llavaneres (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white saltire of Saint Andrew throughout, its arms one sixth of the height, charged at the centre with a green palm frond.
history: The official flag of the municipality is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a white saltire of Saint Andrew throughout, its arms 1/6 of the height of the flag.

features.role: saltire with arms 1/6 of the height
